verdict.rationale: OpenHands' site describes this exact workflow: an automation that reviews security alerts, validates the finding, updates the affected code and opens a pull request with the fix (docs-10). The GitHub README says automations can run on a schedule or in response to webhook events from GitHub and similar tools (gh-4), which covers the 'automatically' part. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how security-alert sources are ingested and how validation works, any configuration guide for this automation, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing copy.
